data.name: Vigilia
data.gender_notes: Vigilia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'vigilare' meaning 'to keep watch', Vigilia is a name of great significance in Christian tradition. It symbolizes the steadfast faith and unwavering watchfulness of those who keep guard over their beliefs and values. In the Bible, the word 'vigil' is used to describe the night watches of the faithful, and the name Vigilia is a reminder of their dedication and perseverance.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to stay alert and faithful in our spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Vigilia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Vigilance, watchfulness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vigilia total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Vigilia
in_english.meaning: watch, vigil, night watch, nocturnal or night-time
in_english.long_meaning: Vigilia is a term derived from the Latin words 'vigilia' meaning watch or vigil, and 'noctis' meaning night. In Christian tradition, Vigilia is used to refer to the night before a major feast day or a significant event, such as the night before Christmas or Easter Sunday. It is also used to describe a period of watchfulness or prayer, as in the phrase 'Vigil of the Lord.'
